t: You're on Cadogan Place, a street in Belgravia that runs parallel to the lower half of Sloane Street. It's named after Earl Cadogan, and it's owned by Cadogan Estates. It gives its name to the Cadogan Place Gardens, private communal gardens for residents. Three naval officers died on this street. Admiral Sir Charles Ekins served in the Fourth Anglo-Dutch War and the Napoleonic Wars. Captain Isaac Schomberg, a combative officer, spent his last fifteen years writing a history of naval operations around Britain. Vice-Admiral Sir Thomas Herbert fought in the Napoleonic Wars and the First Anglo-Chinese War, and later sat as an MP for Dartmouth.
